preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(l) <= 1_000_000 for l, c in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:3]))
preconditions.description: Each block length in t and s is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and len(c) == 1 for l, c in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:3]))
preconditions.description: Each block character in t and s is a single lowercase English letter.
The first line contains exactly two integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 200,000).
The number of blocks in t (n) matches the number of block descriptions provided.
The number of blocks in s (m) matches the number of block descriptions provided.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the number of occurrences of s in t, bounded by the maximum possible occurrences given the constraints.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= p < len(t) and t[p:p+len(s)] == s for p in range(len(t) - len(s) + 1) if p in occurrences)
postconditions.description: For every starting position p in the set of occurrences, the substring of t starting at p of length |s| exactly matches s.
The output integer equals the number of valid starting positions p where s occurs in t.
